identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Relugolix in Men With Advanced Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: HERO: A Multinational Phase 3 Randomized, Open-label, Parallel Group Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Relugolix in Men With Advanced Prostate Cancer

interventions.name: Relugolix
interventions.description: Relugolix 120-mg tablet administered orally once daily following an oral loading dose of 360 mg (3 x 120-mg tablets) on Day 1

interventions.name: Leuprolide Acetate
interventions.description: Leuprolide acetate depot suspension, 22.5 mg (or 11.25 mg in Japan, Taiwan, and China), every 3 months by subcutaneous injection
